subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Increased pulse-width in the flat-top sampling, leads
to
(a)
Attenuation of high frequencies in reproduction.
(b) Attenuation of low frequencies in reproduction.
(c)
Greater aliasing errors in reproduction.
(d) No harmful effects in reproduction.

options.text: Attenuation of high frequencies in reproduction.
Attenuation of low frequencies in reproduction.

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-29 (Signal & System).
